description: Welcome to the Preserve, one of Tumwater’s sought-after communities, where comfort, style, and everyday living come together. This move-in-ready 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath home offers 2,448 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space. Step inside to discover a bright, open layout and an inviting atmosphere. The kitchen is the heart of the home, featuring quartz countertops, a generous island, gas range, and stainless steel appliances—perfect for everyday living and entertaining. The living room offers a cozy fireplace, while French doors open to a private office ideal for working from home. Upstairs, four bedrooms and a versatile loft provide room to relax, work, or create a space of your own. A tankless water heater adds convenience. Outside, the backyard is ready for play and making memories, complete with a playhouse and swing set. Just one block away, a city-owned park offers even more opportunities to enjoy the outdoors. With inviting living spaces, room to grow, and a desirable location in the Preserve, this is a home you’ll want to experience in person. Schedule your private showing today!
